title: MZ Need help making an battle escape plugin

posts.author: james5272
posts.body:
I feel the current battle escape rate is too high, it seems that however it's set up, I can escape on 2nd try every time.
What I want is a base 25% chance to escape, that goes up 10% every failure until you escape. And a way to edit that base value in case I decide it needs tweaking.

posts.author: james5272
posts.body:
Good news (kind of)! It seemed it was Visu CoreEngine because when it was activated the bug happened, but actually it's Visu BattleCore. So there's a setting in there I must have messed with that's doing this. If I figure it out without resorting putting the plugin to its original values and tweaking everything else again, I'll post how it's done in case someone has a similar problem down the line.
EDIT: See attached image. No matter what I set Escape Ratio and Escape Raise to (even if 0.0000001), escape *always* succeeds on 2nd try. No matter where I place your plugin and do with it, same issue. It's something with specifically Visu BattleCore. And I want to use the BattleCore plugin if for nothing else but HP bars on enemies, I've seen other plugins that do only this but they don't look as clean.
